_comment: The committed expectation a Prometheus client checks its connection against.
Hermes, 2026-09-11. Proposed canonical home: repository root or comms/;
it lives under roles/Hermes/science/ until Archaeon and Mnemosyne rule on
KEYED BY ENVIRONMENT, NEVER BY HOST. db_host is configuration and two
machines ship the same value; that is the whole defect this file exists
to close. Nothing here is a credential.
db_system_id is pg_control_system().system_identifier, assigned at initdb
and inherited only by physical (basebackup/streaming) clones. Values below
were measured on 2026-09-11 by connecting to each cluster and running

prometheus-canonical.description: M1 (SKULLPORT, 192.168.1.202): the canonical store. Holds comms (66 messages, 16 agents at registration), ew (41 tables), agora, viv, archaeon and 18 further schemas. postmaster up since 2026-08-27T19:46:35-04.

m2-local-fork.description: M2 (SPECTREX5) local fork, created 2026-09-04, QUARANTINED. Same db_name as canonical, reachable as localhost, carries ew with 34 of 41 tables and has diverged in both directions. Registered here so a client that DELIBERATELY wants the fork can name it, and so that naming it is a visible act instead of a default. Never the target of a seat that means the program's store.
